text:
lydia_cs: Heads up — Parallax QBR prep. Renewal in 2 weeks. Primary asks: 90d token burn breakdown, 30/60/90 forecast, any embedding-heavy spikes, and a short enablement plan for cost saves.

miguel_ops: can you paste the raw 90d? I want to check whether their prefix cache is enabled.

zoe_finops: pulling now. initial quick read shows a recent jump from scheduled batch runs — might be cost scheduling not product usage.

dev-bot: usage-report generated: https://redwood-reports.internal/usage/parallax/1779992468 (report ID 77b4)

sanjay_se: saw 3 big vector jobs last week that lined up with spike. they look like nightly re-embeds from a downstream pipeline. asked infra team to confirm owner.

zoe_finops: paste snippet:
```
Period,Tokens,Avg_Rate_per_1k
2026-01-01_to_2026-01-31,8,450
2026-02-01_to_2026-02-28,12,470
2026-03-01_to_2026-03-15,20,510
Projected_30d,18,505
Projected_60d,16,490
Projected_90d,14,475
```

miguel_ops: if Projected_30d is 18k and they have a reserved commit of 25k, runway looks fine but bursts push over commit. Are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

lydia_cs: they're on Hosted with a moderate commit. Renewal ask will want a path to stabilize unit costs.

cleo_cs_manager: action list: Zoe — finalize 30/60/90 CSV by EOD tomorrow. Miguel — confirm whether embedding cache + prefix cache are enabled and whether autoscale rules triggered. Sanjay — trace the 3 vector jobs and propose a throttle/cadence change. Lydia — draft the QBR slide with 2 recommended options (throttle + scheduled cache priming).

zoe_finops: noted. attaching a short forecast table I'll use for the slide.

sanjay_se: quick throttle proposal:
- cap concurrent embed jobs to 4
- schedule heavy re-embeds at 0300 UTC with reduced batch size
- add a canary on first run to verify model variant (v1 -> v1-quant)

miguel_ops: cache: prefix KV cache is ON for their main route but embedding cache was not configured for 90d retention — enabling 7d retention lowers costs ~18% in our sim. I can enable a 7d policy in staging for validation.

lydia_cs: perfect. can everyone comment with ETA? we need a slide pack by Friday COB for the QBR deck.

zoe_finops: ETA EOD tomorrow for CSV + projections.

miguel_ops: I can validate cache change in staging by tomorrow noon, production change pending stakeholder sign-off.

sanjay_se: tracing job owners now, will report back in 2 hours.

cleo_cs_manager: good. I'll set a short enablement call with Parallax for Wed 10am PT to walk through the throttle + cache play. Lydia will lead. :thumbsup:

lydia_cs: added to calendar, will prep a one-pager that shows expected cost delta (current vs throttle vs cache).

zoe_finops: FYI forecast delta summary: current run-rate -> $12.4k/mo, with cache -> $10.2k/mo, with throttle -> $9.1k/mo. conservative combined -> $8.7k/mo.

lydia_cs: that's gold — we'll use conservative combined for renewal ask and explain options.

dev-bot: reminder: QBR slide template v3 available at https://redwood-assets/internal/qbr-template-v3.pptx

miguel_ops: quick note — if they accept a dedicated commit, unit price changes will alter the math. include a slide showing commit vs hosted cost.

cleo_cs_manager: agreed. final: Zoe + Miguel + Sanjay to sync by tomorrow 11am PT, then Lydia will assemble slides. Thanks team.
